## {.center}

<div class="canvas">

<div class="header-row">
<div class="header-title">
<div class="title-main">wt End-to-End Idea-to-Software Workflow</div>
<div class="title-sub">Turning a stray thought into finished, working software — and learning from the results.</div>
</div>
<div class="loop-callout">
<div class="loop-callout-title">↻ A Loop, Not a Line</div>
<div class="loop-callout-sub">What we learn at the end informs what we do next. Every cycle makes the next idea better.</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="stage-row">

<div class="stage-col">
<div class="stage-head"><span class="stage-num capture">1</span><span class="stage-name capture">Capture</span></div>
<div class="stage-card capture">
<div class="stage-icon">💡</div>
<div class="stage-desc">Jot the idea down the moment it occurs.</div>
<hr/>
<div class="stage-how">How:</div>
<ul>
<li><code>wt idea</code></li>
<li><code>wt-capture</code> skill</li>
<li><code>wt-seed</code> skill <span class="dim">(from a conversation)</span></li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>

<div class="flow-arrow">→</div>

<div class="stage-col">
<div class="stage-head"><span class="stage-num explore">2</span><span class="stage-name explore">Explore</span></div>
<div class="stage-card explore">
<div class="stage-icon">🔍</div>
<div class="stage-desc">Research, ask questions, and write down what we learn.</div>
<hr/>
<div class="stage-how">How:</div>
<ul>
<li><code>wt idea log</code></li>
<li><code>wt idea summary</code></li>
<li><code>wt idea questions</code></li>
<li><code>wt-explore</code> skill <span class="dim">(does the research and records it)</span></li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>

<div class="flow-arrow">→</div>

<div class="stage-col rework-anchor">
<div class="stage-head"><span class="stage-num spec">3</span><span class="stage-name spec">Spec</span></div>
<div class="stage-card spec">
<div class="stage-icon">📄</div>
<div class="stage-desc"><strong>Create the Spec:</strong> Decision, Design, and Done checklist.</div>
<hr/>
<div class="stage-how">How:</div>
<ul>
<li><code>wt spec new</code></li>
<li><code>wt-new-work</code> skill <span class="dim">(authxxs the spec)</span></li>
</ul>
<div class="stage-note">🛡️ Spec must be formally accepted before moving forward.</div>
</div>
<div class="rework-callout">
<div class="rework-title">↩ Needs Revision?</div>
<div class="rework-skill"><code>wt-rework</code> skill</div>
<div class="rework-sub">Sends it back for revision if incomplete or wrongly designed.</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="flow-arrow">→</div>

<div class="stage-col">
<div class="stage-head"><span class="stage-num export">4</span><span class="stage-name export">Export</span></div>
<div class="stage-card export">
<div class="stage-icon">📦</div>
<div class="stage-desc">Hand off the Spec to the owning team or codebase.</div>
<hr/>
<div class="stage-how">How:</div>
<ul>
<li><code>wt spec export</code></li>
<li><code>wt-export</code> skill</li>
</ul>
<div class="stage-note">Self-contained handoff. No special access needed back.</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="flow-arrow">→</div>

<div class="stage-col">
<div class="stage-head"><span class="stage-num implement">5</span><span class="stage-name implement">Implement</span></div>
<div class="stage-card implement">
<div class="stage-icon">&lt;/&gt;</div>
<div class="stage-desc">Build the solution according to the spec and plan.</div>
<hr/>
<div class="stage-how">How:</div>
<ul>
<li><code>wt-implement-spec</code> skill</li>
</ul>
<div class="stage-note">Checks work against the plan and only marks it done when it's true.</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="flow-arrow">→</div>

<div class="stage-col">
<div class="stage-head"><span class="stage-num close">6</span><span class="stage-name close">Close the Loop</span></div>
<div class="stage-card close">
<div class="stage-icon">🔄</div>
<div class="stage-desc">Bring results back and measure real fit.</div>
<hr/>
<div class="stage-how">How:</div>
<ul>
<li><code>wt spec pull-status</code></li>
<li><code>wt spec pull-clock</code> <span class="dim">(pull build progress and effort/time back)</span></li>
<li><code>wt spec fit-log</code> <span class="dim">(record whether it solved the problem)</span></li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>

</div>

<div class="bottom-row">

<div class="exit-block">
<div class="exit-caption">Not every idea reaches Implement — and that's healthy. An idea can be closed at any time with:</div>
<div class="exit-row">
<div class="exit-card dropped">
<div class="exit-head">⊗ Dropped</div>
<div class="exit-desc">A reasoned won't-do.</div>
<div class="exit-how">Closed with: <code>wt idea close</code></div>
</div>
<div class="exit-card researched">
<div class="exit-head">★ Researched</div>
<div class="exit-desc">Fully explored, but no separate build was needed — its value folded into something else.</div>
<div class="exit-how">Closed with: <code>wt idea close</code></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="exit-note">Both are legitimate, healthy outcomes.</div>
</div>

<div class="visibility-band">
<div class="visibility-title">Full Visibility, Read-Only</div>
<div class="visibility-row">
<div class="vis-card">
<div class="vis-head">▦ wt hub</div>
<div class="vis-desc">Overview of everything in flight, across all stages.</div>
</div>
<div class="vis-card">
<div class="vis-head">☰ wt next</div>
<div class="vis-desc">What to work on next, across all stages.</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

</div>

</div>

</div>
</div>
